DiLG DACONO P'L'P'NAS Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA cor. Quezon Avenue, west Triangle, Quezon City wwwxli'q.qqy,ph OPINION NO S. FEB 2 6 2025 CONCERNED CITIZENS Poblacion 4, Pasuquin Province of Ilocos Norte Dear Concerned Citizens: This refers to your letter requesting for this Department's opinion on the following matters, we quote verbatim: l. In January 2024 one of our elected Barangay Kagawad has resigned to his position, leaving it empty and vacant. But only for a couple of days, as our Punong Barangay Rosario Tagupa has appointed Mr. Edgar Peralta as a replacement, without any consultation, disregarding us voters. My question is, is it legal?; 2. Also in October 2024 one of our elected barangay kagawad has died, which was then again replaced by our Punong Barangay Rosario Tagupa, by appointing Mr. Nestor Aquin without voters consultation. Is it legal?; 3. We also heard that our Municipal Mayor, Robert Aguinaldo will be the one to choose who will be the next Barangay Kagawad to be appointed. Is this legal? We will answer the following points of clarification under one discussion. Section 45 (a) (3) of the Local Government Code of 19911 provides for the manner of appointment in case there is a permanent vacancy in the Sangguniang Barangay. The appointing authority is the Mayor, upon recommendation of the Sanggunian concerned. There is no showing that the Mayor should consult first with the registered voters of the concerned Local Government Unit (LGU) before making an appointment. The aforementioned provision used the word "shall". It must be emphasized that the word "shall" connotes mandatory character, it indicates a word of command, and one which has always or which must be given a compulsory meaning, and it is generally imperative or mandatory in nature.2 Section 45. Permanent Vacancies in the Sanggunian (a) Permanent vacancies in the sanggunian where automatic succesions provided above do not apply shall be filled by appointment in the following manner: (l) xxx (2) xxx (3) The city or municipal mayor, in the case of sangguniang barangay upon recommendation of the sangguniang concerned. 2 UCPB General Insurance Company, Inc. vs. Hughes Electronics Corporation, GR No. 190385, November I l, 2016 "Matino, Mahusay, at Maaasahan" Tel. (02) 8876-3454

Likewise, the recommendation of the concerned sangguniang barangay in favor of the appointee is also mandatory being an element in the process of the appointment by the city or municipal mayor, We would like to emphasize that Section 45 (a) (3) of the LGC used the phrase "upon recommendation of the sangguniang concerned" not upon the recommendation of the Punong Barangay alone This opinion is being rmdered without prejudice to contrary opinion or ruling which may be rendered by cotnpetent authorities and the proper courts Very truly yours. BY AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY A . ROMEO P. B NITEZ Undersecretary for External, Legal and Legislative Affairs Page 2 of2
